name: Game MONUSCO (Norwegian Military Academy)
description: Matrix game developed at the Norwegian Military Academy modeling UN peacekeeping operations, specifically the MONUSCO mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Uses argument-based adjudication to capture the complex emergent dynamics of multi-actor peacekeeping environments involving armed groups, civilian populations, UN agencies, and host-nation forces. Documented in the Scandinavian Journal of Military Studies.
reputation: academically documented matrix game used in Norwegian Military Academy PME; peer-reviewed in Scandinavian Journal of Military Studies
notes: Based on the Engle Matrix Game methodology. Specifically designed for peacekeeping education to expose students to the multi-actor complexity of UN operations in DRC. Peer-reviewed article in Scandinavian Journal of Military Studies.
